text: The company’s FY revenue of $7.887 bn and a 61.7% YoY revenue jump in Q2FY27, together with a 20.4% EBITDA margin that beat the 18‑20% guidance range, support the bullish narrative of strong top‑line growth and management delivering on measurable guidance. However, the decline in EBITDA margin from 23.6% to 12.5% since FY22, a stretched working‑capital cycle, and operating cash flow covering only 0.88 × PAT undermine the positive story.
